node.statement: Base case P(1): U_1=C_1 and B^(1)=B_{C_1}. Take v_1 to be the one root-supplied initial current reset isomorphism v_{C_1}:B_{C_1}->A_{C_1}, without changing its witness. Its recorded field and recorded defect and unit estimates are exactly epsilon_{C_1} <= W.L*epsilon, d_{C_1} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{C_1}, and ||v_{C_1}(I_{B_{C_1}})-u_{A_{C_1}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{C_1}, so it witnesses P(1).
